source: ExportArcanes.json（官方结构化逐级数值）+ dict.zh/en 渲染描述
note: levels[].values 为各级的数值槽（路径 → 数值）；bucket 对应 docs/乘区归属表.md
scope: 仅收录武器可用赋能（主要·/次要·/近战·/神威·/和平·/残差·/弓箭·/霰弹·/双枪·/瀑流·/联结·/分形·）

skipped.name: 近战·坚壁
skipped.reason: 近战·坚壁：近战击杀 +210 护甲，只加护甲、不改武器伤害

skipped.name: 神威·勇武
skipped.reason: 神威·勇武：重击击杀回能量，属战甲能量层

skipped.name: 和平·高飞
skipped.reason: 和平·高飞：只影响精准度/后坐力/飞身瞄准时长

skipped.name: 和平·电充
skipped.reason: 和平·电充：电池充电延迟，只影响弹药循环

skipped.name: 和平·电闪

description.en: While sliding or aim gliding: Gain 65% ammo efficiency with Dual Pistols.
description.zh: 滑行或处于飞身瞄准时：使用双持手枪获得 65% 的弹药效率。

description.en: On Ability Cast: Next shot gains a Damage Multiplier for every 200 current Energy, up to x8.
description.zh: 施放技能时：当前每拥有 200 能量，下一次射击伤害增加 1 倍，最高可达 8 倍。

description.en: On Ability Cast: Gain 60% Corrosive Damage on Melee strikes for 25s. Stacks up to 240%.
description.zh: 使用技能后：近战攻击获得 60% 腐蚀伤害，持续 25 秒。最多叠加到 240% 伤害。

description.en: +200% Additional Combo Count Chance on Lifted enemies
description.zh: 对浮空敌人有 +200% 额外连击数几率

description.en: Gain 1.0x Critical Damage for every 10% <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Status chance on your Melee Weapon.
description.zh: 每 10% 近战武器 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺触发几率可获得 1.0 倍暴击伤害加成。

description.en: Gain +1% damage for each unit of armor past 1,000, up to a max of +500%.
description.zh: 超过 1,000 护甲值的每一点护甲，增加 1% 伤害，最高可增加 500%。

description.en: Enemies affected by Status Effects gain 6 additional stacks when they're knocked down or flung by melee attacks.
description.zh: 受到异常状态影响的敌人在被近战攻击击倒或击飞时，增加 6 层额外异常状态层数。

description.en: On Ground Slam: 50% chance to pull enemies within 12m into melee range.
description.zh: 震地攻击时： 50% 的几率将 12 米内的敌人拉至近战范围。

description.en: On Shield Break: +150% Melee Damage on Heavy Attack and Heavy Attack kills restore +30% of max Shields for 20s.
description.zh: 护盾被打破时： +150% 在重击时的近战伤害 和 重击击杀可恢复 +30% 最大护盾值，持续 20 秒。

description.en: On Melee Hit: Gain 42% Critical Chance on your next Heavy Attack, up to 420%
description.zh: 近战命中时：下一次重击获得 42% 暴击几率，最多获得 420% 暴击几率。

description.en: On Headshot: Gain +300% damage on your next shot.
description.zh: 造成爆头后：下一次射击 +300% 伤害。

description.en: After a Bullet Jump or Double Jump: Melee while Aim Gliding launches a projectile that explodes on impact
description.zh: 旋身飞跃或二段跳后： 飞身瞄准时进行近战会射出一个投射物，并在撞击后爆炸

description.en: After a Bullet Jump or Double Jump: Slam emits a shockwave forwards that suspends enemies in the air for a short period
description.zh: 旋身飞跃或二段跳后： 震地攻击向前放出一道冲击波，将敌人悬停在空中一小段时间。

description.en: Gain 30% Melee Damage for every 200 current Shields, up to 420%. Bonus halved for Overshields.
description.zh: 当前每拥有 200 护盾，获得 30% 近战伤害，最多获得 420% 近战伤害。通过过载护盾获得的增益减半。

description.en: On Melee <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status: 20% chance for elemental Melee Status Effects to apply to enemies within 20m for 18s. Cannot refresh while active.
description.zh: 近战造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态时：有 20% 几率使 18 秒内近战攻击触发的元素异常状态施加于 20 米内的敌人上。效果激活时无法刷新。

description.en: On swapping to Secondary Weapon, consume all Combo Multipliers to increase Secondary Weapon Critical Chance and Critical Damage by 20% per Combo consumed for 30s.
description.zh: 切换到次要武器时消耗所有连击倍率，每层消耗的连击倍率增加 20% 的次要武器暴击几率和暴击伤害，持续 30 秒。

description.en: While at or above 90% Energy: Gain 35% of Max Energy as Multishot, capped at 350%.
description.zh: 当能量值达到或超过 90% 时：获得最大能量值的 35% 作为多重射击，上限为 350%。

description.en: Gain 1 Overguard for every 100 Damage dealt to an enemy's Overguard.Deals x8 Extra Damage to Overguard.
description.zh: 每对敌人的超宏防护造成 100 伤害，便获得 1 超宏防护。对超宏防护造成 x8 额外伤害。

description.en: On Finisher Kill: Gain 6 Initial Combo for the rest of your mission
description.zh: 处决击杀时：永久获得 6 初始连击，直到任务结束

description.en: On <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect: +3% Critical Damage and +2.25% Multishot for 12s. Stacks up to 40x.
description.zh: 触发 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态时： +3% 暴击伤害 和 +2.25% 多重射击，持续 12 秒。最多叠加到 40 层。

description.en: On Kill: +30% Damage for 4s. Stacks up to 12x.+30% Reload Speed
description.zh: 击杀时： +30% 伤害，持续 4 秒。最多叠加到 12 层。+30% 装填速度

description.en: On Melee Kill: +60% Damage for 20s. Stacks up to 6x.+7.5s Combo Duration
description.zh: 近战击杀时： +60% 伤害，持续 20 秒。最多叠加到 6 层。+7.5 秒连击持续时间

description.en: On Headshot Kill: +120% Damage for 24s. Stacks up to 3x.+30% to Headshot Multiplier-50% Weapon Recoil
description.zh: 爆头击杀时： +120% 伤害，持续 24 秒。最多叠加到 3 层。+30% 爆头倍率-50% 武器后坐力

description.en: On Reload: Deal increased damage per round loaded based on max magazine size. Lasts for 10s.
description.zh: 装填时：每装填一发子弹可根据最大弹匣容量增加伤害。持续 10 秒。

description.en: On Weapon <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact Status Effect: +1.2 Energy Regen/s for 10s. Stacks up to 3x.
description.zh: 武器触发 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击异常状态： 每秒恢复 +1.2 能量，持续 10 秒。最多叠加到 3 层。

description.en: On <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Status Effect: +3.6% Critical Damage and +1.8% Multishot for 12s. Stacks up to 40x.
description.zh: 触发 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态时： +3.6% 暴击伤害 和 +1.8% 多重射击，持续 12 秒。最多叠加到 40 层。

description.en: On Weapon <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>Magnetic Status Effect: Enemy weapons jam within 15m of target. Cooldown 10s.
description.zh: 武器触发 <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>磁力异常状态时：目标 15 米内的敌人武器会被干扰。冷却时间 10 秒。

description.en: Kill an enemy affected by <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>Magnetic Status for a 45% chance to pull in enemies within 18m radius
description.zh: 击杀受到 <DT_MAGNETIC_COLOR>磁力异常状态影响的敌人时有 45% 几率将半径 18 米内的敌人拉近。

description.en: On hitting enemies afflicted by 10 stacks of <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation: Deal 180% of the hit damage to enemies within 7m.
description.zh: 命中受到 10 层 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射影响的敌人时：对 7 米范围内的敌人造成 180% 的命中伤害。

description.en: On Base Critical Hits: 100% chance for your attack to strike a second time
description.zh: 基础暴击命中时：有 100% 几率施加第二次攻击。

description.en: On <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR> Puncture: Apply 3 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold stacks on targets within 15m.
description.zh: 造成 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR> 穿刺时：对 15 米内的敌人施加 3 层 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> 冰冻异常状态。

description.en: While Buffing Ally Warframes: +20% Critical Chance per buff
description.zh: 为友军战甲提供增益时：每个增益 +20% 暴击率。

description.en: On Hit: Increase Critical Chance by 10%. Resets after 6 Big Critical Hit.
description.zh: 命中时：增加 10% 暴击几率。在 6 次强力暴击命中后重置。

description.en: On <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status Effect: +12% Damage for 10s. Stacks up to 480%.
description.zh: 触发 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰异常状态时： +12% 伤害，持续 10 秒。最多叠加到 480%。

description.en: On Kill: +30% Damage for 4s. Stacks up to 12x.+30% Reload Speed
description.zh: 击杀时： +30% 伤害，持续 4 秒。最多叠加到 12 层。+30% 装填速度

description.en: On Melee Kill: +60% Damage for 20s. Stacks up to 6x.+7.5s Combo Duration
description.zh: 近战击杀时： +60% 伤害，持续 20 秒。最多叠加到 6 层。+7.5 秒连击持续时间

description.en: On Precision Headshot Kill: +120% Damage for 24s. Stacks up to 3x.+30% to Headshot Multiplier-50% Weapon Recoil
description.zh: 精准爆头击杀时： +120% 伤害，持续 24 秒。最多叠加到 3 层。+30% 爆头倍率-50% 武器后坐力

description.en: Enemies take +45% damage per <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status
description.zh: 每层 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态会使敌人受到 +45% 的伤害

description.en: On <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status Effect: +1.5% Reload Speed and +3% Multishot for 12s. Stacks up to 40x.
description.zh: 触发 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态时： +1.5% 装填速度 和 +3% 多重射击，持续 12 秒。最多叠加到 40 层。

description.en: On Headshot Kill: 4 projectiles burst from the target and seek the heads of nearby enemies.
description.zh: 爆头击杀时： 在目标身上炸裂出 4 发自动导向邻近敌人头部的飞射物。

description.en: On shotgun kill within 5m of target: +180% Multishot and +75% Reload Speed for 15s.
description.zh: 在目标 5 米以内使用霰弹枪击杀时： +180% 多重射击 和 +75% 装填速度，持续 15 秒。

description.en: If an enemy has 10 stacks of a combined Status Effect, inflicting the same Status Effect again has a 100% chance to inflict one of the base Status Effects it is composed of.
description.zh: 如果敌人身上叠加了 10 层复合异常状态，再次造成相同的异常状态有 100% 的几率施加组成该异常状态的基础异常状态之一。

description.en: On Weak Point Hit: Gain +30% Status Chance and +6% Ammo Efficiency for 10s. Stacks up to 10x.
description.zh: 命中弱点时：获得 +30% 触发几率和 +6% 弹药效率，持续 10 秒。最多可叠加 10 层。

description.en: +50% Additional Combo Count Chance
description.zh: +50% 额外连击数几率

description.en: On Status Effect: 50% chance to deal 200% Weapon Damage to enemies within 6m.
description.zh: 触发异常状态时： 50% 的几率对 6 米内的敌人造成 200% 的武器伤害。

description.en: On Kitgun Kill: 20% chance to spawn volatile hives for 12s that explode when enemies approach for 80 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage in 10m. Standing in the area applies <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage type to Theorem Arcanes.
description.zh: 用组合枪击杀时： 20% 几率触发 生成不稳定的巢囊，持续 12 秒，在敌人靠近时，巢囊爆炸，并在 10 米内造成 80 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。站在该区域内会对定理赋能施加 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰伤害。

description.en: On aim: x0.2 explosion radius, +100% damage and +5.5% ammo efficiency for every 1m radius lost.
description.zh: 瞄准时：爆炸范围为 0.2 倍，且每缩小 1 米范围，增加 100% 伤害与 5.5% 弹药效率。

description.en: On Status Effect: +24% chance to trigger a second random Status Effect.
description.zh: 触发异常状态时：+24% 几率触发第二个随机异常状态。

description.en: x2.50 Melee Damage against Frozen enemies. On Roll: <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Freeze enemies in a 5.5m radius with a 2s Cooldown.
description.zh: 对被冰冻的敌人造成近战伤害 x2.50。翻滚时：<DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻 5.5 米范围内的敌人，冷却时间为 2 秒。

description.en: On Kitgun Kill: 20% chance to create a frigid mist for 12s, dealing 40 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage/s. Standing in the area applies <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Damage to Theorem Arcanes.
description.zh: 用组合枪击杀时： 20% 几率触发 制造一片持续时间为 12 秒的寒雾，每秒造成 40 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害。站在该区域内会对定理赋能施加 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻伤害。

description.en: On Kitgun Kill: 20% chance to spawn an electrified spike for 12s, dealing 200 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to enemies within 10m. Standing in the area applies <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to Theorem Arcanes.
description.zh: 用组合枪击杀时： 20% 几率触发 生成电脉冲柱，持续 12 秒，对 10 米范围内的敌人造成 200 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。站在该区域内会对定理赋能施加 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

description.en: On Kitgun Kill: 20% chance to create pool of toxic blood for 12s, dealing 40 <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage/s. Standing in the area applies the <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage to Theorem Arcanes.
description.zh: 用组合枪击杀时： 20% 几率触发 制造持续时间为 12 秒的毒性血池，每秒造成 40 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。站在该区域内会对定理赋能施加 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素伤害。

description.en: On Ability Cast: +240% Reload Speed for 5s
description.zh: 使用技能后： +240% 装填速度，持续 5 秒

description.en: While Overshields Active: +300% Critical Chance
description.zh: 「过载护盾」处于激活状态时：+300% 暴击几率。

description.en: On Roll: +300% Critical Chance on Weakpoint Hits for 4s
description.zh: 翻滚时： +300% 命中弱点暴击几率，持续 4 秒

description.en: On Status Effect: Deals +750 Damage matching the Damage Type of the Status Effect
description.zh: 触发异常状态时： 造成与异常状态类型匹配的 750 伤害
